# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion


class StatisticalArbitrageAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        self._target = self.add_equity("KO", Resolution.DAILY)
        self._peer = self.add_equity("PEP", Resolution.DAILY)

        self._model = OLSRegressionModel()
        self._residual_std_deviator = StandardDeviationOfResiduals(self._model)
        self._z_score = ZScore(self._residual_std_deviator)

        self.warm_up_model(self._target.symbol, self._peer.symbol)

    def warm_up_model(self, target: Symbol, peer: Symbol) -> None:
        history = self.history[PEP](target, 60, Resolution.DAILY)
        for data_point in history:
            self._model.fit(data_point.time, data_point.end_time, data_point.close, data_point.close)
        self._residual_std_deviator.update(self._target, self._peer, 60)
        self._z_score.update(self._residual_std_deviator)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        if not self._z_score.is_ready:
            return

        target_price = self._target.price
        peer_price = self._peer.price
        residual = target_price - self._model.predict(peer_price)

        if not self._target.invested and residual < -2 * self._residual_std_deviator.current.value:
            self.set_holdings(self._target, 1, True)
        elif not self._peer.invested and residual > 2 * self._residual_std_deviator.current.value:
            self.set_holdings(self._peer, 1, True)
        elif (self._target.invested or self._peer.invested) and abs(residual) < 0.5 * self._residual_std_deviator.current.value:
            self.liquidate(self._target, self._peer)
